source_bound_findings.claim: Hawk resumes completed samples and in-progress samples that reached a checkpoint, while samples that never checkpointed restart from the beginning.

Hawk's crash-resume smoke tests deliberately crash after a durable checkpoint and verify restored host/sandbox state; they validate post-checkpoint resume rather than a pre-first-provider-call write-ahead intent.

Hawk's prior-attempt diagnostic explicitly describes unfinished samples starting over across pod replacement/retry and records a production case where 4,588 logical samples became 6,013 attempts after three OOM kills.

Inspect creates a realtime sample row before plan execution when realtime logging is enabled, but TaskLogger.start_sample writes only to the local SampleBufferDatabase and is not the checkpoint authority.

Inspect checkpoint I/O is agent-driven: checkpointer setup is inert until the agent enters checkpointer(), and durable fires occur on tick/checkpoint or a clean final agent_complete checkpoint. Therefore current source does not establish a durable content-bound provider-dispatch intent before the first model/provider call.

bounded_conclusion: Inspect/Hawk provides useful post-checkpoint recovery, but the inspected current paths do not source-bind a durable semantic evaluation/provider intent before the first provider effect. The uncovered gap is specifically the interval before the first durable checkpoint; it is not a claim that all resumed model calls are duplicated.

idempotent_reconcile_mode.kill_boundary: provider effect durably accepted before controller reads response
idempotent_reconcile_mode.interpretation: Stable content-bound idempotency key plus reconcile-before-execute recovers the accepted-but-unrecorded effect without duplicate cell effects.

nonidempotent_no_reconcile_mode.kill_boundary: provider effect durably accepted before controller reads response
nonidempotent_no_reconcile_mode.interpretation: Without provider idempotency or reconciliation, a durable DISPATCHING state must not be blindly replayed; restart fails closed with zero additional provider calls.

reference_test.scope: Local HTTP provider process and SQLite authority exercise real inter-process transport and SIGKILL ordering, but do not establish exactly-once behavior for arbitrary external providers.

post_freeze_head_drift.action: not adopted; semantic work stopped and only frozen-tuple checkpoint/receipt writes continue

exact_next_action: On the next fresh-control invocation, resolve the then-current control tuple first. Then source-bind concrete synchronous provider APIs for durable idempotency and retrieve/reconcile semantics at provider-accepted-to-local-unrecorded boundaries, classifying idempotent+reconcile, idempotent-only, reconcile-only, or neither. Extend the HTTP reference with a DISPATCHING-but-no-remote-effect crash case and a provider-process crash immediately after durable effect commit; require safe same-key retry only where the provider contract proves it, otherwise retain UNKNOWN/fail-closed semantics.
